structure.unit: Crimes Against the Administration of Justice

law.catch_line: Fine and imprisonment by court limited unless jury impaneled
law.text: No court shall, without a jury, for any such contempt as is mentioned in the first class embraced in § 18.2-456, impose a fine exceeding $250 or imprison more than ten days; but in any such case the court may, without an indictment, information or any formal pleading, impanel a jury to ascertain the fine or imprisonment proper to be inflicted and may give judgment according to the verdict.
